choices.content: The normal vectors of the two planes
One direction vector chosen from each plane, and they must be parallel
Arbitrary vectors from the two planes
Vectors from the origin to the two planes

question.prompt: To determine whether two planes are perpendicular, which two vectors are checked for perpendicularity?

solutions.explanation: Use the normal vectors for the determination: if the normal vectors are perpendicular, the planes are perpendicular.
solutions.title: Choose the normal vectors
